blocking_rules.requirement: Every machine-readable schema element generated for schema freeze must have an SPM-1 entry.
Schema freeze rejects any schema element without SPM-1 provenance or with unauthorized semantic source.
Any generator that emits schema artifacts or SPM-1 provenance entries must be enrolled as SchemaProvenanceGenerator.

Each schema artifact/SPM-1 entry must bind exact input design identities, generator executable/runtime identity, workload attestation, generation event, output digest, provenance-map digest, and signature.

permitted_now: construct and test a non-authoritative SPG-1 candidate
prepare schema inventory without emitting authority-bearing frozen schemas
prohibited_now: treat manually authored schema output as frozen authority
implement runtime behavior from unfrozen schema artifacts
